title: Flutter Navigator/Theme.of crashes after await with disposed BuildContext
symptoms: Looking up a deactivated widget's ancestor is unsafe
Crash after awaiting a network call then calling Navigator.of(context)
Works if the user stays on the screen; fails if they pop early
cause: BuildContext from a widget that unmounted during the async gap is used after the Element is deactivated.
solution: Capture the Navigator/Router before the await when appropriate, or check context.mounted (or mounted on State) before using context after awaits.
workaround: Disable the button and ignore late responses with a cancelled flag / package request cancellation.
